findings.title: Wrong terminal owner deadline failure tuple
findings.detail: Held-upload and core propagation checks expect the request-poll cleanup_pending tuple instead of the terminal owner deadline result. Preserve the exact cached failure across short-D, late cleanup and core stop.

snapshot_assessment: Public docs require retained unresponsive source ownership but do not specify post-abort active_requests field representation. Preserve original completion and Gaoxy credits; record public snapshot separately. No dependency defect established.
